flows:
Navigate to https://scribo.cc then Scroll down through the whole page once, to the bottom.
Then, check whether the text 'Try Pro free for 7 days' appears anywhere on the page and store the answer, true or false, as 'claim_1'.
store whether the text '$4.99 per month' appears as 'claim_2'.
store whether the text 'Prices are shown in the App Store for your country' appears as 'claim_3'.

remark: scroll: Scrolling to the bottom of the page
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, "whether the text 'Try Pro free for 7 days' appears anyw
wait: Waiting after all required task actions and checkpoint analyses have completed

summary:
Scrolled through the Scribo page to the bottom as requested.
The page showed “Try Pro free for 7 days.”
The page did not show “$4.99 per month.”
The page showed “Prices are shown in the App Store for your country.”
